s0301.literal: On jihai day Jupiter transgressed East Saltern.
s0301.idiomatic: On jihai day Jupiter transgressed East Saltern.

s0302.literal: On xinchou day the Henan Land-tax Overall Directorate was established, subordinate to the Inner Secretariat Office; one post each of darughachi, director, and associate director, and two deputy directors were appointed, rank secondary third grade.
s0302.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Henan land-tax overall directorate was established, subordinate to the Inner Secretariat Office; 1 post each of darughachi, director, and associate director, and 2 deputy directors were appointed, rank secondary third grade.

s0303.literal: On wushen day the Brave Champions Office was established, with wrestlers placed under it.
s0303.idiomatic: On wushen day the Brave Champions Office was established, with wrestlers placed under it.

s0304.literal: On gengxu day Datong County had hail as large as chicken eggs.
s0304.idiomatic: On gengxu day Datong County had hail as large as chicken eggs.

s0305.literal: An edict directed that camels, horses, cattle, and sheep be distributed to Mongol commoners in the northern frontier garrisoning the border, enabling them to raise livestock and sustain themselves, and officials were also ordered to deliberate on establishing garrison farms.
s0305.idiomatic: An edict directed that camels, horses, cattle, and sheep be distributed to Mongol commoners in the northern frontier garrisoning the border, enabling them to raise livestock and sustain themselves, and officials were also ordered to deliberate on establishing garrison farms.

s0306.literal: On renzi day the Great Qianyuan Temple was granted ten thousand ingots of notes to invest as capital drawing interest for repair expenses; its intendant office was also raised to an overall directorate, granted a silver seal, rank primary third grade.
s0306.idiomatic: On renzi day the Great Qianyuan Temple was granted 10,000 ingots of notes to invest as capital drawing interest for repair expenses; its intendant office was also raised to an overall directorate, granted a silver seal, rank primary third grade.

s0307.literal: Four hundred thousand ingots of notes were granted to relieve impoverished commoners of the Khalaj division;
s0307.idiomatic: 400,000 ingots of notes were granted to relieve impoverished commoners of the Khalaj division;

s0308.literal: three hundred thousand ingots to relieve qielian retainers of the princes who suffered disaster;
s0308.idiomatic: 300,000 ingots to relieve qielian retainers of the princes who suffered disaster;

s0309.literal: those with salaries and able to support themselves were not to receive grants.
s0309.idiomatic: Those with salaries and able to support themselves were not to receive grants.

s0310.literal: On guichou day ten thousand Household Guard troops were placed under the Eastern Palace.
s0310.idiomatic: On guichou day 10,000 Household Guard troops were placed under the Eastern Palace.

s0311.literal: On bingzi day the Guanghui Office was raised to primary third grade, administering Muslim medicine.
s0311.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Guanghui Office was raised to primary third grade, administering Muslim medicine.

s0312.literal: On dingchou day, because of flooding in Jining and other routes, officials were dispatched to inspect the people; those lacking food were relieved; wine was again banned, lake and marsh prohibitions were lifted, and commoners were permitted to gather food.
s0312.idiomatic: On dingchou day, because of flooding in Jining and other routes, officials were dispatched to inspect the people; those lacking food were relieved; wine was again banned, lake and marsh prohibitions were lifted, and commoners were permitted to gather food.

s0313.literal: Jinyang, Xiliang, Jun, and other prefectures, and Yangzhai, Xinzheng, Mi, and other counties had heavy hail; Bianliang, Yidu, Banyang, Jinan, Dongchang, Dongping, Jining, Tai'an, Gaotang, Puzhou, Huai'an, and other places had major flooding.
s0313.idiomatic: Jinyang, Xiliang, Jun, and other prefectures, and Yangzhai, Xinzheng, Mi, and other counties had heavy hail; Bianliang, Yidu, Banyang, Jinan, Dongchang, Dongping, Jining, Tai'an, Gaotang, Puzhou, Huai'an, and other places had major flooding.

s0314.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on bingchen day Zhao Qinsa of Burma came to audience with tribute goods.
s0314.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on bingchen day Zhao Qinsa of Burma came to audience with tribute goods.

s0315.literal: Lai'an Route director Cen Shixing rebelled and seized Tangxing Prefecture; an imperial letter was sent summoning him to submit.
s0315.idiomatic: Lai'an Route director Cen Shixing rebelled and seized Tangxing Prefecture; an imperial letter was sent summoning him to submit.

s0316.literal: Prince Kuosanjian's following was impoverished; grain was granted in relief.
s0316.idiomatic: Prince Kuosanjian's following was impoverished; grain was granted in relief.

s0317.literal: On renxu day the moon transgressed Heart.
s0317.idiomatic: On renxu day the moon transgressed Heart.

s0318.literal: Ten thousand troops of the Jeliqiyar Myriarch Office were placed under the Eastern Palace; the Right Guard Commandant's Office was established, rank primary third grade.
s0318.idiomatic: 10,000 troops of the Jeliqiyar Myriarch Office were placed under the Eastern Palace; the Right Guard Commandant's Office was established, rank primary third grade.

s0319.literal: On dingmao day an edict directed Jiangxi officials and powerful locals not to obstruct the tea tax.
s0319.idiomatic: On dingmao day an edict directed Jiangxi officials and powerful locals not to obstruct the tea tax.

s0320.literal: On jiaxu day the Emperor's elder sister Grand Princess Sangge Ragi performed Buddhist rites and released twenty-seven serious offenders of Quanning Prefecture; an edict ordered an inquiry into Quanning defending official Acong's unlawful conduct, and the released prisoners were still pursued and returned to prison.
s0320.idiomatic: On jiaxu day the Emperor's elder sister Grand Princess Sangge Ragi performed Buddhist rites and released 27 serious offenders of Quanning Prefecture; an edict ordered an inquiry into Quanning defending official Acong's unlawful conduct, and the released prisoners were still pursued and returned to prison.

s0321.literal: An order directed that from among the Nurgan exiled prisoners those whose crimes were somewhat lighter be selected for garrison farming at Zhaozhou.
s0321.idiomatic: An order directed that from among the Nurgan exiled prisoners those whose crimes were somewhat lighter be selected for garrison farming at Zhaozhou.

s0322.literal: On yihai day three granaries were added at Tongzhou and Huozhou.
s0322.idiomatic: On yihai day 3 granaries were added at Tongzhou and Huozhou.

s0323.literal: On bingzi day Venus transgressed the Right Law Enforcer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0323.idiomatic: On bingzi day Venus transgressed the Right Law Enforcer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0324.literal: Two officials each were added at the Shangdu patrol office and Kaiping County.
s0324.idiomatic: 2 officials each were added at the Shangdu patrol office and Kaiping County.

s0325.literal: On jimao day the people under Prince of Jin Yesun Temür, having suffered plunder and disaster, included many who turned to banditry; an edict directed jarghuchi Nangjiadai to go with the Prince of Jin's inner secretariat to examine and record criminal prisoners; serious cases were to be reported to the Prince of Jin for execution on the spot; those deserving exile or banishment were to receive increased beatings.
s0325.idiomatic: On jimao day the people under Prince of Jin Yesun Temür, having suffered plunder and disaster, included many who turned to banditry; an edict directed jarghuchi Nangjiadai to go with the Prince of Jin's inner secretariat to examine and record criminal prisoners; serious cases were to be reported to the Prince of Jin for execution on the spot; those deserving exile or banishment were to receive increased beatings.

s0326.literal: On gengchen day Mulin and Maidai two relay stations were granted twelve thousand one hundred twenty ingots of notes to buy horses for the relay service.
s0326.idiomatic: On gengchen day Mulin and Maidai two relay stations were granted 12,120 ingots of notes to buy horses for the relay service.

s0327.literal: On xinsi day one hundred forty thousand ingots of notes were granted to the left and right hawking establishments and impoverished Khalaj and others.
s0327.idiomatic: On xinsi day 140,000 ingots of notes were granted to the left and right hawking establishments and impoverished Khalaj and others.

s0328.literal: Eighth month, on jiaxu day Zhang Siming, commissary of the Hedong-Shanxi Circuit Pacification Commission, was made central secretariat associate administrator.
s0328.idiomatic: Eighth month, on jiaxu day Zhang Siming, commissary of the Hedong-Shanxi Circuit Pacification Commission, was made central secretariat associate administrator.

s0329.literal: On yiyou day Mars transgressed Ghost.
s0329.idiomatic: On yiyou day Mars transgressed Ghost.

s0330.literal: On jiawu day, because the crown prince was granted the jade seal, announcement sacrifice was performed at the Southern Suburb.
s0330.idiomatic: On jiawu day, because the crown prince was granted the jade seal, announcement sacrifice was performed at the Southern Suburb.

s0331.literal: On gengzi day the imperial carriage arrived from the Upper Capital.
s0331.idiomatic: On gengzi day the imperial carriage arrived from the Upper Capital.

s0332.literal: On dingwei day announcement sacrifice was performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.
s0332.idiomatic: On dingwei day announcement sacrifice was performed at the Grand Ancestral Temple.

s0333.literal: That month Fuxiang County had a mountain collapse.
s0333.idiomatic: That month Fuxiang County had a mountain collapse.

s0334.literal: Intercalary eighth month, on bingchen day Mercury transgressed the Right Law Enforcer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0334.idiomatic: Intercalary eighth month, on bingchen day Mercury transgressed the Right Law Enforcer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0335.literal: Prince of Jia Huanghuo Temür's following was granted one hundred thousand sheep and ten thousand horses.
s0335.idiomatic: Prince of Jia Huanghuo Temür's following was granted 100,000 sheep and 10,000 horses.

s0336.literal: On gengshen day the Xinghe Route Preparedness Granary was added, rank primary eighth grade;
s0336.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Xinghe Route Preparedness Granary was added, rank primary eighth grade;

s0337.literal: the Guangying Storehouse was raised to secondary eighth grade.
s0337.idiomatic: the Guangying Storehouse was raised to secondary eighth grade.

s0338.literal: On guihai day Mars transgressed Chariot.
s0338.idiomatic: On guihai day Mars transgressed Chariot.

s0339.literal: On jiazi day the moon transgressed Wall Formation.
s0339.idiomatic: On jiazi day the moon transgressed Wall Formation.

s0341.literal: On renshen day Grand Tutor and censor-in-chief Boghu was made Grand Preceptor.
s0341.idiomatic: On renshen day grand tutor and censor-in-chief Boghu was made grand preceptor.

s0342.literal: On guiyou day an edict stated: "Officials of the Hedong-Shanxi Circuit Pacification Commission shall receive salaries equal to those attending court.
s0342.idiomatic: On guiyou day an edict stated, "Officials of the Hedong-Shanxi Circuit Pacification Commission shall receive salaries equal to those attending court.

s0343.literal: " An edict stated: "For all offices, those who receive appointment but do not take office, or avoid heavy duties and leave post on pretext, their appointment commissions shall be revoked."
s0343.idiomatic: An edict stated, "For all offices, those who receive appointment but do not take office, or avoid heavy duties and leave post on pretext, their appointment commissions shall be revoked."

s0344.literal: On yihai day Venus transgressed East Saltern.
s0344.idiomatic: On yihai day Venus transgressed East Saltern.

s0345.literal: Yongxing County was merged into Fengsheng Prefecture.
s0345.idiomatic: Yongxing County was merged into Fengsheng Prefecture.

s0346.literal: Ninth month, on jiaxu day Commissioner of the Palace Administration Duodai was made Grand Tutor; deliberating official of the central secretariat Qincha was promoted to associate administrator.
s0346.idiomatic: Ninth month, on jiaxu day commissioner of the Palace Administration Duodai was made grand tutor; deliberating official of the central secretariat Qincha was promoted to associate administrator.

s0347.literal: On xinmao day twenty-eight relay stations including Tieligan suffered disaster; notes were granted in relief.
s0347.idiomatic: On xinmao day 28 relay stations including Tieligan suffered disaster; notes were granted in relief.

s0348.literal: On renchen day a comet was observed at the Directorate of Astronomy.
s0348.idiomatic: On renchen day a comet was observed at the Directorate of Astronomy.

s0349.literal: On guisi day, because of Buddhist rites, seven prisoners sentenced to death and six prisoners sentenced to exile or below were released.
s0349.idiomatic: On guisi day, because of Buddhist rites, 7 prisoners sentenced to death and 6 prisoners sentenced to exile or below were released.

s0350.literal: On wuxu day sea transport grain was increased by one hundred thousand shi.
s0350.idiomatic: On wuxu day sea transport grain was increased by 100,000 shi.

s0351.literal: Yunnan County was established, subordinate to Yunnei Prefecture.
s0351.idiomatic: Yunnan County was established, subordinate to Yunnei Prefecture.

s0352.literal: Former Baoshan County of Chang Prefecture was made Baochang Prefecture, subordinate to Xinghe Route.
s0352.idiomatic: Former Baoshan County of Chang Prefecture was made Baochang Prefecture, subordinate to Xinghe Route.

s0353.literal: On gengzi day the Shunde and Guangping iron smelting intendant offices were merged into the Shunde-Guangping-Zhangde and other places Iron Smelting Intendant Office.
s0353.idiomatic: On gengzi day the Shunde and Guangping iron smelting intendant offices were merged into the Shunde-Guangping-Zhangde and other places Iron Smelting Intendant Office.

s0354.literal: On guimao day censorate officials said: "Recently offices have been sought through favor, and crimes escaped through bribes; we request that for all inner and outer officials who are not meritorious elders with established reputation, sudden promotion not be permitted.
s0354.idiomatic: On guimao day censorate officials said, "Recently offices have been sought through favor, and crimes escaped through bribes; we request that for all inner and outer officials who are not meritorious elders with established reputation, sudden promotion not be permitted.

s0355.literal: Those who have confessed corruption crimes and those who ought to be tried but escaped through favor shall all be handed to the original investigating officials to complete their punishment;
s0355.idiomatic: Those who have confessed corruption crimes and those who ought to be tried but escaped through favor shall all be handed to the original investigating officials to complete their punishment;

s0356.literal: those who received punishment for corruption, had offices revoked and were barred from reappointment, yet curried favor with intimate attendants, entering and leaving the inner court seeking noble titles, should be driven out."
s0356.idiomatic: those who received punishment for corruption, had offices revoked and were barred from reappointment, yet curried favor with intimate attendants, entering and leaving the inner court seeking noble titles, should be driven out."

s0357.literal: The Emperor accepted all these proposals.
s0357.idiomatic: The Emperor accepted all these proposals.

s0358.literal: An edict stated that those of the four night guards who had once received punishment should not be permitted to enter the forbidden court.
s0358.idiomatic: An edict stated that those of the four night guards who had once received punishment should not be permitted to enter the forbidden court.

s0359.literal: Wine was banned on all Shandong routes.
s0359.idiomatic: Wine was banned on all Shandong routes.

s0361.literal: Grain was issued to relieve famine in Jining, Dongping, Dongchang, Gaotang, Dezhou, Jinan, Yidu, Banyang, Yangzhou, and other routes.
s0361.idiomatic: Grain was issued to relieve famine in Jining, Dongping, Dongchang, Gaotang, Dezhou, Jinan, Yidu, Banyang, Yangzhou, and other routes.

s0362.literal: Tenth month, on jiayin day four posts of metropolitan merit commissioners were cut, leaving only six.
s0362.idiomatic: Tenth month, on jiayin day 4 posts of metropolitan merit commissioners were cut, leaving only 6.

s0363.literal: On yimao day fifteen relay stations by land and water on Dongping and Jining routes lacked food; ten shi of wheat was granted per household.
s0363.idiomatic: On yimao day 15 relay stations by land and water on Dongping and Jining routes lacked food; 10 shi of wheat was granted per household.

s0364.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "White Cloud sect patriarch Shen Mingren forcibly seized twenty thousand qing of civilian fields, deceived one hundred thousand common people, privately bribed intimate attendants, and recklessly received noble titles; by imperial order these have already been recovered; we request his followers be purged and the seized civilian fields returned.
s0364.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "White Cloud sect patriarch Shen Mingren forcibly seized 20,000 qing of civilian fields, deceived 100,000 common people, privately bribed intimate attendants, and recklessly received noble titles; by imperial order these have already been recovered; we request his followers be purged and the seized civilian fields returned.

s0365.literal: His various unlawful matters should be ordered investigated."
s0365.idiomatic: His various unlawful matters should be ordered investigated."

s0366.literal: An imperial rescript stated: "We know Shen Mingren's treachery and wickedness; he shall be strictly interrogated."
s0366.idiomatic: An imperial rescript stated, "We know Shen Mingren's treachery and wickedness; he shall be strictly interrogated."

s0367.literal: On wuwu day central secretariat right chancellor Baidashah was dispatched bearing credentials to confer the jade seal upon the crown prince.
s0367.idiomatic: On wuwu day central secretariat right chancellor Baidashah was dispatched bearing credentials to confer the jade seal upon the crown prince.

s0368.literal: On xinyou day jarghuchi Temür Buqa was made censor-in-chief.
s0368.idiomatic: On xinyou day jarghuchi Temür Buqa was made censor-in-chief.

s0369.literal: On guihai day Mars transgressed the Left Law Enforcer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
s0369.idiomatic: On guihai day Mars transgressed the Left Law Enforcer of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

s0370.literal: The people of Shangdu suffered famine; ten thousand shi of official grain was issued and sold at reduced price for relief.
s0370.idiomatic: The people of Shangdu suffered famine; 10,000 shi of official grain was issued and sold at reduced price for relief.

s0371.literal: Six salt warehouses were established in the Two Zhes, rank secondary eighth grade, two officials each; only Hangzhou and Jiaxing two warehouses had three officials each, rank secondary seventh grade;
s0371.idiomatic: 6 salt warehouses were established in the Two Zhes, rank secondary eighth grade, 2 officials each; only Hangzhou and Jiaxing two warehouses had 3 officials each, rank secondary seventh grade;

s0372.literal: thirty-four salt fields were established, each field with one transport supervisor, rank primary eighth grade.
s0372.idiomatic: 34 salt fields were established, each field with 1 transport supervisor, rank primary eighth grade.

s0374.literal: On yichou day the moon transgressed Hairy Head.
s0374.idiomatic: On yichou day the moon transgressed Hairy Head.

s0375.literal: On dingmao day the northern relay stations were relieved.
s0375.idiomatic: On dingmao day the northern relay stations were relieved.

s0376.literal: On wuchen day the moon transgressed Eastern Well.
s0376.idiomatic: On wuchen day the moon transgressed Eastern Well.

s0377.literal: On gengwu day Venus was seen in daytime.
s0377.idiomatic: On gengwu day Venus was seen in daytime.

s0378.literal: On xinwei day the moon transgressed Chariot.
s0378.idiomatic: On xinwei day the moon transgressed Chariot.

s0379.literal: On bingzi day, because the crown prince received the jade seal, an edict was announced throughout the realm.
s0379.idiomatic: On bingzi day, because the crown prince received the jade seal, an edict was announced throughout the realm.

s0380.literal: On jimao day the Tonghui Canal was dredged.
s0380.idiomatic: On jimao day the Tonghui Canal was dredged.

s0381.literal: One post of vice commissioner was added to the Hedong and Shaanxi salt transport commissions, with two branch-office seals granted;
s0381.idiomatic: 1 post of vice commissioner was added to the Hedong and Shaanxi salt transport commissions, with 2 branch-office seals granted;

s0382.literal: two supervisory offices were established, rank secondary eighth grade, two officials each;
s0382.idiomatic: 2 supervisory offices were established, rank secondary eighth grade, 2 officials each;

s0383.literal: two salt fields were added, with two overseers each added;
s0383.idiomatic: 2 salt fields were added, with 2 overseers each added;

s0384.literal: twenty salt-pan household supervisors were abolished.

s0385.literal: Jinan, Bin, Dizhou, Zhangqiu, and other counties suffered flooding; their field rent was remitted.
s0385.idiomatic: Jinan, Bin, Dizhou, Zhangqiu, and other counties suffered flooding; their field rent was remitted.

s0386.literal: Eleventh month, on xinmao day Mars transgressed Worthy Promotion.
s0386.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on xinmao day Mars transgressed Worthy Promotion.

s0387.literal: Mubang Route's Daibang raided; an edict directed the Yunnan branch secretariat to summon and capture him.
s0387.idiomatic: Mubang Route's Daibang raided; an edict directed the Yunnan branch secretariat to summon and capture him.

s0388.literal: On yisi day Secretariat Director Kushiding was made grand steward.
s0388.idiomatic: On yisi day secretariat director Kushiding was made grand steward.

s0389.literal: On gengzi day an edict directed two thousand impoverished commoners of the Prince of Jin's following to settle at Chenghai garrison farming.
s0389.idiomatic: On gengzi day an edict directed 2,000 impoverished commoners of the Prince of Jin's following to settle at Chenghai garrison farming.

s0390.literal: One post each of associate commissioner and vice commissioner was added to the Capital Region Grain Transport Commission, with a branch-office seal granted.
s0390.idiomatic: 1 post each of associate commissioner and vice commissioner was added to the Capital Region Grain Transport Commission, with a branch-office seal granted.

s0391.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Formerly Prince Ajiji was granted thirty thousand ingots of notes, enabling investment of capital drawing interest to supply hunting establishment provisions, without taking from the people.
s0391.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Formerly Prince Ajiji was granted 30,000 ingots of notes, enabling investment of capital drawing interest to supply hunting establishment provisions, without taking from the people.

s0392.literal: Now his following's Aruqan and others go hunting and recklessly extort from the people, moreover committing wicked deeds; the Imperial Clan Court and Ministry of Punishments should be ordered to interrogate them, applying proper statutory punishment."
s0392.idiomatic: Now his following's Aruqan and others go hunting and recklessly extort from the people, moreover committing wicked deeds; the Imperial Clan Court and Ministry of Punishments should be ordered to interrogate them, applying proper statutory punishment."

s0394.literal: Commoners were forbidden to harbor fugitive slaves of Mongol troops.
s0394.idiomatic: Commoners were forbidden to harbor fugitive slaves of Mongol troops.

s0395.literal: The Emperor addressed censorate officials: "Those who possess a state take the people as foundation.
s0395.idiomatic: The Emperor addressed censorate officials, "Those who possess a state take the people as foundation.

s0396.literal: Recently we hear that many common people suffer hardship and harbor grievances; let supervising censors and surveillance commissions investigate and report."
s0396.idiomatic: Recently we hear that many common people suffer hardship and harbor grievances; let supervising censors and surveillance commissions investigate and report."

s0397.literal: The people of Hejian suffered famine; grain was issued in relief.
s0397.idiomatic: The people of Hejian suffered famine; grain was issued in relief.

s0398.literal: Twelfth month, on renxu day the crown prince was ordered to participate in deciding state affairs.
s0398.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on renxu day the crown prince was ordered to participate in deciding state affairs.

s0399.literal: Song Confucian Zhou Dunyi was enfeoffed Duke of the Way State.
s0399.idiomatic: Song Confucian Zhou Dunyi was enfeoffed Duke of the Way State.

s0400.literal: On jiazi day two jarghuchi of the Imperial Clan Court were dispatched to examine and decide criminal prisoners at Xinghe, Pingdi, and other places.
s0400.idiomatic: On jiazi day 2 jarghuchi of the Imperial Clan Court were dispatched to examine and decide criminal prisoners at Xinghe, Pingdi, and other places.
